rule_text_as_published: The kicking team may declare an onside kick at any time during the game.
prior_regime: 2025: only a trailing team could declare, at any point. 2024: only a trailing team, from the fourth quarter on.
why_it_moves_a_total: Any club, leading or trailing, can now trade field position for a possession at any point. A fourth-quarter comeback curve built on 2025 data assumes the trailing club is the only one that can manufacture an extra possession; that assumption is now false on both sides of the ball.

rule_text_as_published: Modifies the dead ball spot after a touchback when the kickoff is from the 50-yard line.
prior_regime: An out-of-bounds kickoff from the 50 put the ball at the receiving team's 25; a touchback put it at the 35.
why_it_moves_a_total: Closes the deliberate out-of-bounds loophole. Expected starting field position after a penalty-moved kickoff changes, which moves the expected-points value of a penalty-forced kickoff and therefore the total.

rule_text_as_published: Modifies alignment requirements for receiving team players in the setup zone on a kickoff or safety kick.
prior_regime: Six players had to have a front foot on the restraining line; three could be off it.
why_it_moves_a_total: Five on the line, up to four floaters. Changes return geometry, so the touchback rate and the average starting field position of a return are not comparable to 2025 without a re-measured rate.

rule_text_as_published: Permits League personnel to consult with on-field officials on the potential disqualification of a player for both flagrant football and non-football acts, even if not called on the field.
prior_regime: Replay could pick a flag up, never put one down.
why_it_moves_a_total: A late-game ejection removes a starter from the closing drive. Win-probability and total models fitted before 2026 never priced that path.

rule_text_as_published: For one year only, the NFL Officiating department may correct clear and obvious mistakes made by on-field officials that impact the game, in the event of a work stoppage involving the game officials represented by the NFL Referees Association.
why_it_moves_a_total: The official 2026 rulebook's own 2026 Rule Changes table does not list this rule, although the league's approved playing rules summary does. Any regime filter must decide whether this item is in scope before it is priced.
